summary: Toasts that drip out of the top of the screen and get sucked back in.

behavior: Tap a lone toast to dismiss it, or a stack to fan it out; swipe any way to dismiss. Timers and the drain line pause while you drag or the stack is open.

At the top, a toast drips out of the edge on a strand that thins and pinches off, then a card drops out of the pill when there is more to say. Leaving, the card folds up and the pill is sucked back into the edge. In single mode the pill gulps — rises on its strand and drips back with the new toast. At the bottom, toasts rise in. Errors shake once.
No strand or travel: toasts fade in and out in place, the card snaps open and closed, and the error shake is skipped; fades and the spinner stay.
A success, warning or error notification when a toast of that type appears or a promise settles; turn it off with haptics={false}.
Each toast is an alert in a polite live region, labelled by its title and description, with an escape action to dismiss it.
